notices.short_title: Unarmed Security Guards
notices.description: This solicitation is being made pursuant to the M/WBE Noncompetitive Small Purchase Method, Section 3-08 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board (PPB) Rules, this procurement is exclusively for the City Certified Minority and Woman Owned Business (M/WBEs). Contracts awarded under this method may not exceed $1.5 million, inclusive of any and all change orders, overruns, amendments, renewals and extensions. If interested, please respond to this solicitation in Passport. Please submit your proposals by both acknowledging the receipt of the RFx in the Acknowledgement tab and completing your response in the Manage Responses tab. Vendor resources and materials can be found at the link below under the Finding and Responding to RFx heading. If you need help or have a question, submit an inquiry to the MOCS Service Desk https://www1.nyc.gov/site/mocs/systems/passport-user-materials.page
notices.plain: The Commission on Human Rights awarded a $57,276 contract for unarmed security guards to Vision Security Corporation, a certified minority- or women-owned business, through a small noncompetitive purchase.

notices.short_title: 05727Y0678-057270000505- Survival Systems USA Training Facility Use
notices.description:
Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules the New York City Fire Department (FDNY) intends to enter into sole source negotiations with Survival Systems USA to procure Training Tank Facility Use per Specification located in the Documents Tab of this RFI.

Any vendor, besides Survival Systems USA, that believes they can provide Training Tank Facility Use is invited to express its interest by submitting a response in PASSPort. Complete the Acknowledgement tab and submit a response in the Document Submision Tab. If you have questions about the details of the RFx please submit them through the Discussion with buyer tab.

Vendor resources and materials can be found at the link below under the Findings and Responding to RFx (Solicitations) heading:https://www.nyc.gov/assets/mocs/downloads/PASSPort/learning-to-use-passport/Finding_and_Responding_to_RFx_Vendor_Manual.pdf

If you need additional assistance, please contact MOCS Service desk at https://mocssupport.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/8, once there click on Request Assistance to Submit your question.
notices.plain: The Fire Department intends to negotiate directly with Survival Systems USA for use of a training tank facility, without open competition, and will accept responses from other vendors through Dec. 1, 2026.

notices.short_title: Supported SRO Housing Services
notices.description:
Pursuant to Section 3-04(b)(2)(ii) of the Procurement Policy Board (PPB) Rules, the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) intends to enter into a Negotiated Acquisition with The Jericho Project to provide housing and support services for young adult individuals or parents in a congregate supportive housing setting.

Competitive Sealed Bidding or Competitive Sealed Proposals are neither practical nor advantageous due to the limited number of vendors available and qualified to perform these specialized services, as evidenced by the Human Resources Administration (HRA) RFP (EPIN 09617I0006). This open-ended RFP remains open because the City is attempting to increase supportive housing stock. Because the HRA RFP remains open, DOHMH does not anticipate receiving alternative expressions of interest for current supporting housing units.

The Jericho Project has demonstrated satisfactory performance. The proposed contract term is for 9 years, with an anticipated start date of January 1, 2027, and a total procurement value of $11,053,955.00

This notice is for informational purposes only.
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene plans to award a nine-year, $11,053,955 contract without open competition to The Jericho Project, starting Jan. 1, 2027, to provide housing and support services for young adults or parents in supportive housing.

notices.short_title: Temporary Security Staffing
notices.description:
NYC Health + Hospitals Hospital Police department is seeking qualified vendors to provide Temporary Security Staffing Services to support a range of needs across the enterprise. Staff will be provided upon request at all locations to include Acute Care Hospitals, Long Term Care facilities, Ambulatory Clinics, and office locations. 

The objective of this RFP is to identify vendors to streamline the allocation of resources pertaining to the planning, procuring, and scheduling of temporary security staff as needs are identified at the Systems facilities. The awarded vendor will be expected to provide metrics in support of improved efficiencies around temporary security staff recruitment and placement.
notices.plain: NYC Health + Hospitals is seeking proposals from vendors to provide temporary security staffing across its hospitals, long-term care facilities, clinics and offices, with responses due Dec. 18, 2026.

notices.short_title: November 18, 2026 Public Hearing
notices.description:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the following matters have been scheduled for Public Hearing by Community Board:

BOROUGH OF BROOKLYN

COMMUNITY BOARD NO. 18 Wednesday, November 18, 2026, 7:00 P.M., Board Office Meeting Room, 1097 Bergen Avenue, Brooklyn, NY 11234 and via Zoom for participants who wish to participate online.
  
    Geoffrey Roehm, Executive Director of Runway Green, will provide a presentation on the organizations plans to transform a 7-acre site at Floyd Bennett Field into an environmental and agricultural education campus. Runway Green has secured a 60-year lease with the National Park Service to develop the site, which will offer educational programming focused on clean energy, building decarbonization, sustainable agriculture, and marine science. This Statutory Public Hearing has been duly advertised in the City Record. - Vote

Please Note:

·         Zoom Videoconferencing information for community residents who wish to view the meeting is as follows: 

Join from PC, Mac, iPad, or Android:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89739935412?pwd=7JIUWeGQAb5YCZ9KKoxwPXjYSseMFH.1
Passcode:259…
notices.plain: Brooklyn Community Board No. 18 will hold a public hearing on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026, at 7 p.m. at its Bergen Avenue office and via Zoom, where Runway Green's Geoffrey Roehm will present plans for a 7-acre environmental and agricultural education campus at Floyd Bennett Field.
